Re-habilitation and Re- settlement Act, 2013.
It is submitted that being aggrieved by the adequacy of the Award No. 64 passed in connection with LA Case No. 1/2022-23 the Page No.# 3/3 petitioner has filed an application for reference which has not been acted upon.
Let notice be issued, returnable by 6 (six) weeks.
